equations.label: SP-125 parabolic bell inflection and exit point coordinates
equations.quote: The location of Nand E along the nozzle contour
equations.form: N_t = 0.382*R_t*sin(theta_n); N_a = R_t + 0.382*R_t*(1 - cos(theta_n)); E_t = L_n; E_a = R_e; A-1 sample: N_t = 2.19 in, N_a = 12.99 in, E_t = 102.4 in, E_a = 46.7 in
equations.description: Axial (t) and radial (a) coordinates of the parabola start point N on the 0.382 R_t arc and of the exit point E, measured from the throat and the nozzle axis.

variables.meaning: axial distance of point N from the throat
radial coordinate of point N from the nozzle axis
axial distance of exit point E from the throat
radial coordinate of exit point E

assumptions: downstream throat arc of radius 0.382 R_t centred on the throat-plane normal
validity: sample values for theta_n = 27.4 deg, R_t = 12.45 in, R_e = 46.7 in
equations.extraction_note: Original page shows sin(theta_n) in N_t; the Docling candidate misread the subscript as theta_d and is rejected. Independent arithmetic: 0.382*12.45*sin(27.4 deg) = 2.189; 12.45 + 4.756*(1-cos 27.4 deg) = 12.984.

claims.subject: parabolic contour wall angles for epsilon 14 and L_f 0.8
claims.statement: In SP-125 sample calculation 4-2 the parabolic-contour wall angles are derived from Figure 4-14 for epsilon = 14 and L_f = 0.8 as theta_n = 27.4 deg and theta_e = 9.8 deg.
qualifiers: values read on the original PDF page 107; the indexed Markdown renders 27.4 as '274'
single chart readout for the A-1 stage engine; not a general table
claims.quote: The parabolic contour wall angles en and ee can be derived from figure 4-14

claims.subject: 80-percent bell nozzle in sample calculation 4-2
claims.object: a downstream throat arc of radius 0.382 R_t (4.75 in) and a length equal to 80 percent of the equivalent 15 deg conical nozzle
claims.statement: Sample calculation 4-2 designs an 80-percent bell nozzle by the parabolic approximation procedure: the contour downstream of the throat is a circular arc of radius 0.382 R_t (4.75 in), and by definition the nozzle length is 80 percent of that of an equivalent 15 deg half-angle conical nozzle.
qualifiers: source states no claim about shoulder fillets or other 0.8 factors
claims.quote: The nozzle contour downstream of the throat will be a circular arc of radius 0.382

claims.subject: parabolic bell contour completion
claims.object: fitting a parabola through N and E with angles theta_n and theta_e; MOC gives more accurate divergent contours
claims.statement: With the coordinates of N and E and the angles theta_n and theta_e a parabola can be fitted to complete the contour; with a computer program more accurate divergent contours can be calculated by the method of characteristics.
claims.quote: a parabola can be fitted to complete the contour
